newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money edges up to 13.0/14.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money edges up to 13.0/14.5 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money edged up to 13.0/14.5 percent in mid-morning from 12.0/13.0 percent on Thursday despite adequate market liquidity, dealers said.
"It's Friday as usual. Overnight call money often rises despite adequate market liquidity due to expected uncertaintites ahead of the weekend," one state-owned bank dealer said.
The dealer said the market was liquid partly due to early central bank injection of 1.227 trillion rupiah.
Another bank dealer, however, attributed the slight rise to higher rupiah demand due to corporate tax and salary payments.
He said longer-term money was stable, with one-week money trading at 13.75/14.0 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Thursday was 9.42 percent, compared with 9.51 percent on Wednesday.
